name: Map Collectible Markers
author: Kintaro
description: The region map shows the collectibles you have not picked up yet (Black Stone and Amber fragments, Memory Flowers, Major Chests, keys, challenges, unrung bells, gear and about 600 upgrade-material spots) with their names and where they come from; icons under unexplored fog stay hidden. A PBZModLoader mod; settings in a text file in its folder, or on its Mods Menu page.
